title: Peanut Chicken Salad with Ginger and Lime
changes_from_base: Peanut butter, soy, ginger and lime season the mayonnaise; red pepper, jalapeño and coriander replace the celery and tarragon.
summary: Chicken tossed in a peanut, ginger, soy and lime mayonnaise with sliced red pepper, jalapeño and coriander, finished with crunchy peanuts.

steps.title: Poach
steps.text: Start the chicken in cold water with the bay leaf, bring it to a lazy simmer, then cover and turn the heat off. It is done at 74 °C, after 15 min or so. Let it cool before shredding into bite-size pieces.

steps.title: Whisk
steps.text: Whisk the mayonnaise, peanut butter, soy sauce, lime juice and ginger until glossy.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Fold in the chicken, red pepper, jalapeño and most of the coriander; chill 20 min.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Scatter with the chopped peanuts and remaining coriander.

tips: Smooth peanut butter blends into the dressing best.
Add more lime for a sharper salad.
Serve on lettuce leaves or in a wrap.
storage: Keeps covered in the fridge for up to 2 days. Not suitable for freezing. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
